. rediscovering catholic customs every generation inherits traditions from the past which shape our catholic identity. they have been woven into the daily of life, complimenting the liturgical year and enriching personal piety. october and november are rich months for rediscovering catholic customs that may have faded from everyday practice. examples are: praying to our guardian angels as protectors and shepherds; raising our petitions to mary by praying the rosary and meditating on its mysteries; praying the memorare, the angelus, the magnificat , timeless marian prayers which are rich in poetic language and theology.
